speaker: counselor
text: How is the job search going?

speaker: student
text: I'm on an F-1 and my OPT starts after graduation, so I only have so many months to find something.

speaker: counselor
text: What is that like for you?

speaker: student
text: I lie awake doing the math on how many months I have left.

speaker: student
text: Every company says they can't sponsor, so I just stop applying.

speaker: counselor
text: Has anyone from the career office helped?

speaker: student
text: They gave me a list, but half the employers on it do not hire international students at all.

speaker: student
text: I don't know anyone in this industry. My professors know researchers, not hiring managers.

speaker: student
text: Tired. I keep refreshing job boards until 2 a.m.
